name: What should I look for when making a punch list for my construction project?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when making a punch list for my construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: When creating a punch list, meticulously inspect every area of the project. Look for cosmetic flaws like paint imperfections, scratches, or uneven finishes. Check functionality of all installations, such as doors, windows, and fixtures. Ensure all agreed-upon specifications from the contract have been met, and test all systems. Don't overlook details, as small issues can accumulate.
acceptedAnswer.description: When creating a punch list, meticulously inspect for cosmetic flaws, check functionality, and ensure all contract specifications are met.
